about: The manager's test set (MANAGER_AND_DOCS_PLAN §3.4): real requests, the tools each should use and the highest level it may reach. Graded by code (scripts/eval-manager.ts): mustUse = groups, one tool of each group must be called; mustNotUse = never called; maxLevel = the highest level of a call that worked (1 reads, 2 changes with Undo, 3 asks); textMust / textMustNot = patterns on the answer (case-insensitive). setup = state a case needs first (trash_one: a throwaway doc in the trash; work_log: yesterday's work lines; threads: the loop on with three invented threads: a habit, a don't-ask one and a plan with a time; study_doc: a doc they study, "Two pointers, studied", with the sections "Why it works" and "Complexity"). noteUnder = with study_doc, the section a note from Ask AI must land in (checked in the doc); null: no note anywhere. maxWords = the answer's length at most (personal talk is a few sentences). Every change a case makes is undone after it, and a card it leaves is dismissed. Runs on the QA account only.
